title: Yellow Citrusy Australian Shrimp Pasta
description: A floral and springy Australian dish featuring shrimp, citrus, and shredded coconut, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat and add the garlic and cook for 1 minute
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside, leaving the garlic and oil in the skillet
Add the lemon zest and juice to the skillet and stir to combine
Add the shredded coconut to the skillet and stir to combine
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the lemon and coconut mixture
Return the shrimp to the skillet and toss to combine with the pasta and sauce
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately
